my.summary <- function(x){
  s.out <- sum(x)
  l.out <- length(x)
  mean.out <- s.out/l.out
  out <- c(s.out, l.out, mean.out)
  names(out) <- c("sum", "dlzka", "priemer")
  return(out)
}

my.summary(world.pop)

pop <- read_csv("data/UNpop.csv")
class(pop)
